Component names are comparison-local logical responsibilities, not renamings of the v8 reference. Request Interpretation Service (DP2) is the fixed interpretation/adoption boundary. Response Registry does not own business Task completion. Delivery History records presentation evidence, never user understanding or approval. Model integration hexagons labelled VIA are references to detailed common Components on page 26, not extra remote services. No separate OS process or replicated model is implied.

Response Registry is the same instance repeated from page 26. Revision Admission explicitly sends the adopted revision to Generation Lifecycle and Turn Execution and the read order to Playback Selection. A revision key is (responseId, revision, range, generationId). Chunk admission rechecks revision and revocation tombstone. A superseded/revoked revision rejects late chunks. Cancellation for a speech switch does not revoke valid content: valid tail can remain buffered until generation terminal, as in S05. Cancel is best-effort and all tail usage remains billed. Playback Selection revalidates the current key before enqueue; Audio Playout rejects a stale epoch across the check/enqueue race. B Turn Execution rejects late invalid chunks before buffer admission and performs the same validation and keeps already generated valid audio on interruption. Under the basic B design current generation is retained through meaning adoption, cancelled on actual switch to Q1, and ungenerated suffix is generated at return, with additional input context. Short unconfirmed VAD may pause playback without cancelling. Diagram covers generation control; local halt/actual receipts on page 26.
